species.name: Lake trout
why: Water 49°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 32–124 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 65 ft, cold below.

species.name: Trout
why: Water 49°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 26–30 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 65 ft, cold below.

species.name: Northern pike
why: Water 49°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 6–20 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 65 ft, cold below.
Northeast wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the southwest shore: try the wind-blown banks.
